notes.title: Patch v1.11 - v1.15
notes.content:
Patch v1.15

General Bastardo now has Shinigami Note ability.
Knee Jab is now in TP category.
Knee Jab now has 25% base chance to stun instead of 100%.
Chakram no longer removes Light Force buff.
Chakram now also removes Doomed debuff.
Kitsune wasn't supposed to talk in Hermit's Home on the released version.
Chest in Hermit's Home now should be able to be opened when the condition is met.
Guardian Spirits achievement should now unlock properly.


Patch v1.14

Secret Lab switches fixed.


Patch v1.13

Demoralize now appears on TP menus.


Patch v1.12

Talking to a sleeping guard no longer crash the game.
Western exit in Deepforest now delivers the party to the right place.


Patch v1.11

Catz has no longer secret entrances leading back to her shop.
More lighting in Underground Arena.
Talking to a bear no longer crash the game.
Underground Arena crystal now has a proper description.
Underground Arena crystal now lets you leave the arena.
